notes: Executor harness + grading: see README.md 'Skill evals'. Each eval copies fixtures/target-repo to a temp dir, git-inits and commits it as the seed, then a fresh subagent executes skills/process/SKILL.md as /flywheel:process in that dir (eval mode: the sign-off GATE is pre-approved). Grade with: bash skills/process/evals/check.sh <id> <workdir>.

evals.name: new-contract-shape
evals.prompt: /flywheel:process value a used car: given its plate and an asking price in EUR, produce a cheap/fair/overpriced verdict and persist it
evals.setup: cp -r skills/process/evals/fixtures/target-repo "$W" && git -C "$W" init -q && git -C "$W" -c user.email=e@e -c user.name=e add -A && git -C "$W" -c user.email=e@e -c user.name=e commit -qm seed
evals.expected_output: A new contract in .claude/flywheel/processes/ with the full fixed shape: frontmatter, numbered fixed Rules, Output schema, Persistence with an idempotency key, Judgment latitude, Guardrails, Progress reporting naming .claude/flywheel/runs/, and an empty Improvement log.
expectations: A new contract file (not plate-audit.md) exists under .claude/flywheel/processes/
Frontmatter declares name, kind: process and version: 1
A Rules section fixes a numbered deterministic procedure (>= 3 numbered steps)
A Persistence section exists and names an idempotency key
Judgment latitude and Guardrails sections exist
A Progress reporting section names the .claude/flywheel/runs/ telemetry report
An Improvement log section exists and is empty at creation (maturation hook)

evals.name: data-strategy-bootstrap
evals.prompt: /flywheel:process count how many audited plates share the same letter triplet, persisting one row per triplet
evals.setup: cp -r skills/process/evals/fixtures/target-repo "$W" && rm "$W"/.claude/flywheel/DATA.md && git -C "$W" init -q && git -C "$W" -c user.email=e@e -c user.name=e add -A && git -C "$W" -c user.email=e@e -c user.name=e commit -qm seed
evals.expected_output: DATA.md is missing, so the skill creates the repo's data strategy first (Store/Access/Schema/Conventions), then writes the contract against it.
expectations: DATA.md is recreated at .claude/flywheel/DATA.md with Store, Access, Schema and Conventions sections
A new contract file exists under .claude/flywheel/processes/
The contract has the fixed shape: numbered Rules, Output schema, Persistence, Progress reporting, empty Improvement log

evals.name: mature-existing-contract
evals.prompt: /flywheel:process plate-audit: audits must also record a round_number boolean, true when digit_sum is a multiple of 10
evals.setup: cp -r skills/process/evals/fixtures/target-repo "$W" && git -C "$W" init -q && git -C "$W" -c user.email=e@e -c user.name=e add -A && git -C "$W" -c user.email=e@e -c user.name=e commit -qm seed
evals.expected_output: A deliberate revision of the existing contract: version bumped, the change recorded in the Improvement log, the original fixed rules preserved rather than silently rewritten.
expectations: plate-audit.md frontmatter is bumped to version: 2
The Improvement log gains a dated entry recording what changed and why
The original Rule 1 (Normalize) text is still present — rules were revised, not silently rewritten
round_number appears in the Output schema
